{{Otheruses|Zhell}}
The '''Battalions of Zhell''' were the combined military strength of the thirteen nations of [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]]. The Battalions fought the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Notron]] in a [[Zhell–Taung war|war]] for control of their shared [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], and the Zhell emerged victorious.<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-2-ancient-coruscant|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 2 - Ancient Coruscant}}</ref>
